title_sq: Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, tek Pallati me Shigjeta!
description_sq:
Apartamenti eshte i tipologjise 2+1+2 me nje siperfaqe bruto prej 105 m2 dhe neto 94m2.
Organizuar ne ;
- Sallon ndenje me kend gatimi te vecuar dhe tavoline ngrenie,
- 2 dhoma gjumi nje prej te cilave matrimoniale me tualet dhe ballkon dhe nje tualet dite.
- Kendi i gatimit ka ajrim dhe ndricim natyral dhe elektoshtepiake te cilsesiese me te larte.
- Te dyja tualetet jane me ajrim natyral.
- Apartamenti ka nje kaldaje te dedikuar me panel diellor ne tarracen e pallatit e cila eshte mjaft ekonomike per ngrohje gjate stines se dimrit.
- Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne detaje me arkitet para 3 vitesh me nje investim prej 60.000 euro
- Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug perendim, orientim i cili ofron ngrohtesi dhe ndricim natyral.
- Disponon DOKUEMNATCION TE RREGULLUT HIPOTEKORE -
title_en: Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in Palati me Šjetje!
description_en: The apartment is of the 2+1+2 typology with a gross area of ​​105 m2 and a net area of ​​94 m2. Organized in; - Living room with separate kitchen corner and dining table, - 2 bedrooms, one of which is double with toilet and balcony and a day toilet. - The kitchen has natural ventilation and lighting and the highest quality household appliances. - Both toilets have natural ventilation. - The apartment has a dedicated boiler with a solar panel on the terrace of the building, which is quite economical for heating during the winter season. - The apartment was invested in details with architects 3 years ago with an investment of 60,000 euros - The orientation of the apartment is south-west, which provides warmth and natural lighting. - Has PROPER MORTGAGE DOCUMENTATION -
